runny_nose.name: Runny Nose (Rhinorrhea)
runny_nose.description: Excess drainage produced by nasal tissues ranging from clear fluid to thick mucus.

sneezing.name: Frequent Sneezing
sneezing.description: Involuntary convulsive expulsion of air from the lungs through the nose and mouth.

nasal_congestion.name: Nasal Congestion (Stuffy Nose)
nasal_congestion.description: Blockage of nasal passages due to swollen blood vessels and mucous membranes.

sore_throat.name: Sore Throat (Pharyngitis)
sore_throat.description: Pain, scratchiness, or irritation of the throat that often worsens when swallowing.

mild_cough.name: Mild Cough
mild_cough.description: Occasional or mild coughing without significant phlegm.

dry_cough.name: Dry / Hacking Cough
dry_cough.description: Persistent tickling cough that produces little to no phlegm or mucus.

productive_cough_with_phlegm.name: Productive Cough with Phlegm
productive_cough_with_phlegm.description: Cough bringing up thick, discolored, green, yellow, or rusty sputum from the lungs.

persistent_deep_cough.name: Persistent Deep Chest Cough
persistent_deep_cough.description: Racking, deep cough originating from irritated bronchial airways lasting weeks.

clear_yellow_or_green_mucus.name: Clear, Yellow, or Green Bronchial Mucus
clear_yellow_or_green_mucus.description: Airway sputum coughed up from inflamed bronchial passages.

chest_soreness_from_coughing.name: Chest Soreness from Coughing
chest_soreness_from_coughing.description: Sore, bruised sensation across thoracic muscles caused by violent coughing spells.

shortness_of_breath.name: Shortness of Breath (Dyspnea)
shortness_of_breath.description: Difficulty drawing sufficient air, feeling winded, or rapid labored breathing.

mild_shortness_of_breath.name: Mild Breathlessness on Exertion
mild_shortness_of_breath.description: Feeling winded during routine tasks like climbing stairs or walking.

wheezing.name: Wheezing
wheezing.description: A high-pitched musical whistling sound made while breathing, caused by narrowed bronchial airways.

wheezing_rattling_chest.name: Wheezing & Rattling Chest Sound
wheezing_rattling_chest.description: Audible rhonchi and rattling vibratory sensations felt over the chest wall.

chest_tightness.name: Chest Tightness
chest_tightness.description: Feeling of pressure, constriction, or a heavy band wrapped tightly around the chest.

chest_pain_when_breathing.name: Pleuritic Chest Pain (Pain on Inhaling)
chest_pain_when_breathing.description: Sharp stabbing pain when taking a deep breath or coughing.

coughing_at_night.name: Coughing Worse at Night
coughing_at_night.description: Spasmodic cough episodes that disrupt sleep when lying down flat.

facial_pain_and_pressure.name: Facial Pain and Sinus Pressure
facial_pain_and_pressure.description: Aching or fullness over cheekbones, forehead, bridge of nose, or behind eyes.

headache_worse_bending_forward.name: Headache Worse When Bending Forward
headache_worse_bending_forward.description: Throbbing facial pressure that dramatically spikes when lowering head.

thick_yellow_or_green_nasal_discharge.name: Thick Yellow/Green Nasal Discharge
thick_yellow_or_green_nasal_discharge.description: Purulent thick nasal secretions signifying sinus mucosal inflammation.

loss_of_taste_or_smell.name: Loss of Smell or Taste (Anosmia/Ageusia)
loss_of_taste_or_smell.description: Sudden diminution or complete absence of ability to taste foods or perceive odors.

frequent_sneezing.name: Paroxysmal Sneezing Fits
frequent_sneezing.description: Rapid clusters of 5-10 consecutive sneezes triggered by airborne allergens.

clear_runny_nose.name: Profuse Clear Watery Rhinorrhea
clear_runny_nose.description: Thin, watery, drip-like liquid draining continuously from nostrils.

nasal_itching.name: Nasal & Palatal Itching
nasal_itching.description: Intense ticklish itching inside the nose, causing the 'allergic salute' rubbing habit.

postnasal_drip.name: Postnasal Drip
postnasal_drip.description: Sensation of mucus constantly trickling down the back of the throat, prompting throat clearing.

reduced_sense_of_smell.name: Reduced Olfaction (Hyposmia)
reduced_sense_of_smell.description: Muffled ability to appreciate fragrances and food aromas due to blocked clefts.

sudden_severe_sore_throat.name: Sudden Severe Throat Pain (Odynophagia)
sudden_severe_sore_throat.description: Rapid onset of excruciating throat pain making swallowing saliva agonizing.

painful_swallowing.name: Severe Painful Swallowing
painful_swallowing.description: Sharp pain shooting into the ears whenever food, liquids, or saliva is swallowed.

white_patches_pus_on_tonsils.name: White Patches / Exudate on Tonsils
white_patches_pus_on_tonsils.description: Creamy yellowish-white follicular spots of purulent exudate coating enlarged tonsils.

swollen_tender_neck_lymph_nodes.name: Swollen Tender Anterior Neck Nodes
swollen_tender_neck_lymph_nodes.description: Painful palpable pea-to-marble sized lymph glands beneath angle of jaw.

red_spots_on_roof_of_mouth_petechiae.name: Palatal Petechiae (Red Spots on Roof of Mouth)
red_spots_on_roof_of_mouth_petechiae.description: Pinpoint reddish-purple hemorrhages across soft palate.

high_fever.name: High Fever (>101°F / 38.3°C)
high_fever.description: Elevated core body temperature significantly above the standard normal range.

low_grade_fever.name: Low-Grade Fever (99.5°F - 100.9°F)
low_grade_fever.description: Mildly elevated body temperature often accompanied by warmth or slight flush.

chills.name: Chills & Shivering
chills.description: Feeling uncomfortably cold with involuntary muscular shivering and goosebumps.

shaking_chills.name: Violent Shaking Chills (Rigors)
shaking_chills.description: Violent teeth-chattering shaking chills typical of bacteremia or deep infection.

shivering_chills.name: Shivering Cold Paroxysms
shivering_chills.description: Intense cold stage requiring heavy blankets before fever spike.

fatigue.name: Fatigue & Malaise
fatigue.description: Persistent weariness, generalized lack of vitality, and reduced physical stamina.

extreme_fatigue.name: Extreme Exhaustion / Prostration
extreme_fatigue.description: Overwhelming profound exhaustion preventing basic out-of-bed daily functions.

severe_body_aches.name: Severe Body Aches (Myalgia)
severe_body_aches.description: Deep muscular aches throughout back, limbs, and neck.

unexplained_weight_loss.name: Unexplained Weight Loss
unexplained_weight_loss.description: Noticeable drop in body weight without dieting or increased physical exertion.

unexplained_weight_gain.name: Unexplained Weight Gain
unexplained_weight_gain.description: Gaining weight despite no increase in caloric intake or decrease in activity.

sweating.name: Night Sweats / Excessive Perspiration
sweating.description: Profuse drenching sweating, especially soaking clothes or bedsheets.

excessive_sweating.name: Drenching Diaphoresis
excessive_sweating.description: Continuous profuse cold or warm sweats requiring clothing changes.

profuse_sweating.name: Crisis Sweating Stage
profuse_sweating.description: Massive evaporative sweating phase marking end of febrile paroxysm.

weakness.name: Generalized Physical Weakness
weakness.description: Difficulty performing basic muscular movements due to systemic debility.

severe_weakness_and_fatigue.name: Severe Systemic Weakness
severe_weakness_and_fatigue.description: Inability to sustain upright posture without trembling exhaustion.

chronic_fatigue.name: Chronic Lethargy / Sluggishness
chronic_fatigue.description: Constant low energy, sluggish cognitive function, and prolonged morning sleep inertia.

fever_and_chills.name: Fever with Accompanying Chills
fever_and_chills.description: Fluctuating thermal dysregulation with cold spells followed by sweats.

step_ladder_prolonged_fever.name: Prolonged Step-Ladder Fever
step_ladder_prolonged_fever.description: Fever that climbs higher each day in step-like succession, persisting for weeks.

cyclical_high_fever.name: Cyclical Fever Paroxysms (Every 48/72h)
cyclical_high_fever.description: Predictable rhythmic cycles of violent chills, soaring temperatures, and sweats.

cold_intolerance.name: Intolerance to Cold
cold_intolerance.description: Feeling freezing cold and shivering when others are comfortable in room temperature.

excessive_thirst.name: Excessive Thirst (Polydipsia)
excessive_thirst.description: Unquenchable dry mouth and constant craving for water despite high intake.

increased_hunger.name: Increased Appetite (Polyphagia)
increased_hunger.description: Constant gnawing hunger despite eating ample meals.

headache.name: General Headache
headache.description: Diffuse dull ache or pressure spanning the head or forehead.

mild_headache.name: Mild Frontal Headache
mild_headache.description: Mild, nagging tension-type ache across forehead or temples.

severe_headache.name: Severe Splitting Headache
severe_headache.description: Intense head pain causing difficulty focusing or keeping eyes open.

throbbing_headache.name: Intense Throbbing Headache
throbbing_headache.description: Severe pulsating, pounding unilateral or bilateral headache characteristic of migraine.

occipital_headache.name: Occipital / Morning Headache
occipital_headache.description: Dull ache located at base of skull / back of neck upon waking, seen in hypertension.

sensitivity_to_light.name: Sensitivity to Light (Photophobia)
sensitivity_to_light.description: Discomfort or pain in the eyes triggered by normal daylight or room lighting.

sensitivity_to_sound.name: Sensitivity to Sound (Phonophobia)
sensitivity_to_sound.description: Heightened intolerance to normal conversational sounds and ambient noise.

visual_aura.name: Visual Aura (Flashes / Blind Spots)
visual_aura.description: Transient zigzag shimmering lights, scintillating scotomas, or blind patches in vision.

dizziness.name: Dizziness & Lightheadedness
dizziness.description: Feeling woozy, unsteady on your feet, or feeling close to fainting.

spinning_sensation_vertigo.name: Spinning Sensation (True Vertigo)
spinning_sensation_vertigo.description: Hallucination of motion where surroundings violently rotate, tilt, or whirl.

dizziness_triggered_by_head_movement.name: Dizziness Triggered by Head Turn
dizziness_triggered_by_head_movement.description: Sudden vertigo triggered when rolling over in bed, tilting head up, or looking down.

loss_of_balance_unsteadiness.name: Postural Unsteadiness & Dysequilibrium
loss_of_balance_unsteadiness.description: Tendency to veer to one side when walking, feeling pulled down or off-balance.

nausea_with_movement.name: Movement-Induced Motion Sickness
nausea_with_movement.description: Sudden waves of nausea triggered by visual motion or head position changes.

abnormal_rhythmic_eye_movements_nystagmu.name: Rhythmic Involuntary Eye Twitches (Nystagmus)
abnormal_rhythmic_eye_movements_nystagmu.description: Involuntary rapid jerking movements of eyeballs when looking sideways.

blurred_vision.name: Blurred or Fluctuating Vision
blurred_vision.description: Inability to see fine details sharply, often caused by lens osmotic shifts or elevated BP.

tingling_in_feet.name: Numbness / Tingling in Feet (Neuropathy)
tingling_in_feet.description: Pins-and-needles or burning numbness starting in toes and soles of feet.

burning_tingling_nerve_pain.name: Burning Dermatomal Nerve Pain
burning_tingling_nerve_pain.description: Electric, lancinating, or burning pain traced along a single thoracic or facial nerve pathway.

extreme_skin_sensitivity_to_touch.name: Skin Allodynia (Pain from Gentle Touch)
extreme_skin_sensitivity_to_touch.description: Agonizing pain triggered by light contact of a shirt, breeze, or bedsheet on skin.

nausea.name: Nausea
nausea.description: Uneasy sensation in stomach with an involuntary inclination to vomit.

vomiting.name: Vomiting
vomiting.description: Forceful oral expulsion of gastric contents.

nausea_and_vomiting.name: Nausea & Protracted Vomiting
nausea_and_vomiting.description: Persistent recurring nausea culminating in repeated emesis.

watery_diarrhea.name: Watery Diarrhea
watery_diarrhea.description: Frequent loose, unformed, watery liquid bowel evacuations.

abdominal_cramps.name: Abdominal Cramping
abdominal_cramps.description: Spasmodic painful clenching sensations across middle or lower stomach.

abdominal_pain.name: Generalized Abdominal Aching
abdominal_pain.description: Continuous dull or diffuse abdominal soreness.

cramping_abdominal_pain_relieved_by_defe.name: Cramping Pain Relieved by Defecation
cramping_abdominal_pain_relieved_by_defe.description: Lower belly cramps that noticeably subside immediately after passing stool or gas.

chronic_bloating_and_gas.name: Chronic Bloating & Flatulence
chronic_bloating_and_gas.description: Distended belly feeling tight as a drum, excessive gas expulsion.

alternating_diarrhea_and_constipation.name: Alternating Diarrhea & Constipation
alternating_diarrhea_and_constipation.description: Bowel unpredictably swinging between watery stools and stubborn hard pellets.

mucus_in_stool.name: Clear or White Mucus in Stool
mucus_in_stool.description: Jelly-like mucosal strands coating bowel movements without blood.

heartburn.name: Heartburn (Pyrosis)
heartburn.description: Burning sensation rising from epigastrium up into mid-chest and retrosternal area.

acid_regurgitation.name: Acid Regurgitation
acid_regurgitation.description: Sour, bitter, acidic gastric juice backing up into the mouth or throat.

chest_discomfort.name: Retrosternal Chest Burning
chest_discomfort.description: Uncomfortable warmth or tight burning behind the breastbone after eating.

difficulty_swallowing.name: Difficulty Swallowing (Dysphagia)
difficulty_swallowing.description: Sensation of food traveling slowly or pausing behind the sternum.

sour_taste_in_mouth.name: Sour Acidic Taste in Mouth
sour_taste_in_mouth.description: Metallic or vinegar-like sour reflux taste lingering on posterior tongue.

burning_stomach_pain.name: Burning Stomach Pain (Epigastric)
burning_stomach_pain.description: Gnawing burning epigastric discomfort located between the navel and breastbone.

pain_worse_on_empty_stomach.name: Pain Worse on Empty Stomach
pain_worse_on_empty_stomach.description: Stomach burning that intensifies 2-3 hours after meals or at 2 AM, relieved temporarily by food.

loss_of_appetite.name: Loss of Appetite (Anorexia)
loss_of_appetite.description: Marked disinterest in eating meals or feeling early satiety.

right_lower_quadrant_abdominal_pain.name: Right Lower Abdomen Pain
right_lower_quadrant_abdominal_pain.description: Sharp, intense localized pain in McBurney's point (right pelvic lower quadrant).

pain_starting_near_navel_moving_to_lower.name: Periumbilical Pain Migrating to Lower Right
pain_starting_near_navel_moving_to_lower.description: Classic appendicular pain pattern migrating over 12-24 hours.

rebound_tenderness.name: Rebound Tenderness
rebound_tenderness.description: Pain that becomes sharply worse when abdominal pressure is suddenly released.

constipation.name: Infrequent Hard Stools (Constipation)
constipation.description: Fewer than 3 bowel movements per week with straining and hard dry stools.

burning_urination.name: Burning Sensation During Urination (Dysuria)
burning_urination.description: Sharp stinging or scalding pain along the urethra while passing urine.

painful_burning_urination.name: Severe Painful Dysuria
painful_burning_urination.description: Intense scalding pain and urethral spasm upon voiding.

frequent_urination.name: Frequent Urination (Frequency)
frequent_urination.description: Needing to urinate far more often than usual throughout day and night.

urgency_to_urinate.name: Urgent Need to Urinate
urgency_to_urinate.description: Sudden, compelling, uncontrollable urge to pass urine immediately.

frequent_need_to_urinate.name: Persistent Urge with Little Urine Passed
frequent_need_to_urinate.description: Running to the restroom frequently only to pass tiny trickles of urine.

cloudy_urine.name: Cloudy or Malodorous Urine
cloudy_urine.description: Turbid, murky, or pungent-smelling urine indicating presence of white cells or bacteria.

blood_in_urine.name: Blood in Urine (Hematuria)
blood_in_urine.description: Pink, red, or smoky brownish discoloration of urine.

severe_sharp_flank_pain.name: Severe Sharp Flank Pain (Renal Colic)
severe_sharp_flank_pain.description: Excruciating intermittent spasms in the side and back beneath the ribs.

pain_radiating_to_groin.name: Pain Radiating Down to Groin / Scrotum / Labia
pain_radiating_to_groin.description: Referred ureteral pain traveling along the path of urinary obstruction.

skin_rash.name: Skin Rash / Erythema
skin_rash.description: Widespread redness, maculopapular bumps, or spotted eruptions across skin.

intense_skin_itching.name: Intense Skin Itching (Pruritus)
intense_skin_itching.description: Severe irritating sensation prompting an overwhelming compulsion to scratch.

red_to_brownish_skin_patches.name: Red to Brownish Scaly Patches
red_to_brownish_skin_patches.description: Inflamed, dry, lichenified plaques on flexural creases, hands, or cheeks.

dry_scaly_skin.name: Dry, Flaky, Cracking Skin
dry_scaly_skin.description: Loss of cutaneous moisture causing rough peeling texture and fissure development.

skin_cracking.name: Painful Fissures & Skin Cracks
skin_cracking.description: Deep cuts or fissures opening in thickened dry skin creases.

dry_skin_and_hair_loss.name: Coarse Dry Skin & Brittle Hair
dry_skin_and_hair_loss.description: Thinning, coarse brittle hair and rough, pale scaly skin.

unilateral_band_of_blistering_rash.name: Unilateral Band of Blistering Rash
unilateral_band_of_blistering_rash.description: A distinct stripe or cluster of red bumps and blisters restricted strictly to one side of torso or face.

fluid_filled_blisters_along_dermatome.name: Fluid-Filled Vesicular Blisters
fluid_filled_blisters_along_dermatome.description: Clusters of clear fluid-filled blisters that later turn yellowish and crust over.

watery_eyes.name: Watery Eyes (Epiphora)
watery_eyes.description: Excess tear overflow running down the face from conjunctival irritation.

itchy_watery_eyes.name: Intense Itching & Redness of Eyes
itchy_watery_eyes.description: Irritated, itchy conjunctiva prompting frequent eye rubbing.

pain_behind_eyes.name: Severe Retro-Orbital Pain (Pain Behind Eyes)
pain_behind_eyes.description: Deep aching pain behind eyeball globes exacerbated by ocular movement.

redness_in_white_of_eye.name: Redness in White of Eye (Pink Eye)
redness_in_white_of_eye.description: Bright pink or fiery red dilation of conjunctival capillaries.

eye_itching_or_burning.name: Ocular Itching, Stinging, or Burning
eye_itching_or_burning.description: Irritating hot burning or intense scratching sensation on conjunctival surface.

discharge_crusting_eyelids_shut.name: Eyelid Crusting & Pus Discharge
discharge_crusting_eyelids_shut.description: Sticky mucus or yellow crust cementing eyelids glued shut upon waking.

gritty_foreign_body_sensation.name: Gritty Sensation (Sand in Eye)
gritty_foreign_body_sensation.description: Constant feeling as if coarse grains of sand or eyelash is trapped under eyelid.

joint_pain_with_movement.name: Joint Pain with Movement
joint_pain_with_movement.description: Aching pain in knees, hips, or fingers aggravated by walking or weight-bearing.

joint_stiffness.name: Joint Stiffness (Morning <30 mins)
joint_stiffness.description: Difficulty flexing joints upon waking that eases with gentle warm-up movement.

joint_swelling.name: Joint Swelling and Warmth
joint_swelling.description: Fluid buildup and puffy distension around joint capsule.

crepitus_grating_sound.name: Joint Crepitus (Crackling / Crunching)
crepitus_grating_sound.description: Crunching, grinding, or popping sound and sensation felt when flexing knee or hip.

sudden_excruciating_big_toe_pain.name: Excruciating Big Toe Joint Pain (Podagra)
sudden_excruciating_big_toe_pain.description: Sudden onset violent pain, erythema, and hypersensitivity in the base joint of the big toe.

joint_redness_and_heat.name: Joint Redness and Heat
joint_redness_and_heat.description: Inflamed skin over joint glowing hot, fiery red, and tense.

pain_peaks_at_night.name: Joint Pain Waking from Deep Sleep
pain_peaks_at_night.description: Sudden nighttime inflammatory peak causing waking in agonizing pain.

swollen_inflamed_joint.name: Puffy Hot Tense Joint Distension
swollen_inflamed_joint.description: Rapid ballooning of joint with tense fluid collection.

severe_joint_and_bone_pain.name: Severe Joint and Bone Pain ('Breakbone')
severe_joint_and_bone_pain.description: Excruciating deep-seated pain in bones, knees, and lumbar spine.
